IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long black hair and
wispy bangs laughs with her eyes crinkled and
cheeks flushed. She wears a bright blue track
jacket with white side stripes and black gloves, and
holds a handful of snow. Snow-covered mountains
rise behind her under a clear blue sky. Bright,
natural sunlight with warm highlights, a palette of
royal blue, white, and crisp black. Candid and
joyful, in the style of a winter travel photo.
